Tom Ford Ultra Shine Lip Color – 03 Nubile

A luxurious hybrid lip color that combines the rich payoff of a lipstick, the glossy shine of a lip gloss, and the nourishing comfort of a lip balm. Shade 03 Nubile is a soft, elegant nude that enhances your natural lip tone with a luminous, high-shine finish.

Key Benefits 
• Hydrating Formula: Infused with moisturizing ingredients to keep lips soft, smooth, and comfortable throughout the day
• Lip-Friendly Texture: Lightweight, non-sticky formula that glides effortlessly on the lips
• Nourishing Feel: Helps prevent dryness and leaves lips feeling conditioned
• High-Shine Finish: Gives a plump, healthy-looking shine without heaviness
• Buildable Coverage: Can be worn sheer for a natural look or layered for enhanced color payoff
• Flattering Nude Shade: Perfect for everyday wear, office looks, and elegant glam makeup

results.name: NYX Professional Makeup Jumbo Eye Pencil

product.title: NYX Professional Makeup Jumbo Eye Pencil
product.description:
NYX Professional Makeup Jumbo Eye Pencil combines an eyeshadow and eyeliner all-in-one!

Benefits:
Features a creamy formula that glides on smoothly like silk and is easy to blend
Does not crease or dry out
Available in an astounding array of shades that work both day and night
Lasts all day
How to Apply

To use pencil as eyeshadow, apply all over the eye and in the crease; blend carefully. To line eyes apply pencil directly along the upper and lower lash lines and blend. Can be used with all NYX Professional Makeup eyeshadows, liners, mascara and lashes.

Pro tip:
Use Jumbo Eye Pencils to create fun costume, and festival makeup looks on the face and body.

results.name: SHEGLAM Sunburst Glow Mixer

product.title: SHEGLAM Sunburst Glow Mixer
product.description:
SHEGLAM Sunburst Glow Mixer Foundation in Fair Neutral is a lightweight, buildable liquid foundation enhancer designed to give your skin a radiant, sun-kissed glow.
Its silky formula blends seamlessly into the skin, delivering a luminous, dewy finish while evening out the complexion. You can use it alone for a natural glow, mix it with foundation for added radiance, or apply it as a liquid highlighter on high points of the face.

Perfect for creating bright, youthful, glowy makeup looks without feeling heavy.

 Key Benefits
• Adds instant glow & radiance to any makeup look
• Lightweight, smooth & blendable formula
• Can be mixed with foundation or worn alone
• Provides a dewy, fresh-skin finish
• Enhances complexion without cakiness
• Suitable for all skin types
• Fair Neutral shade works best for fair to light skin with neutral undertone

 How to Use

1. As a Glow Mixer:
Mix 1–2 drops with your liquid foundation for a luminous, radiant finish.

2. As a Liquid Highlighter:
Apply directly on cheekbones, nose bridge, cupid’s bow, and brow bones.

3. As a Light Base:
Use a thin layer alone for a natural glow on no-makeup days.

4. Blend Properly:
Use fingertips, a blending sponge, or a foundation brush for a smooth finish.
